crossRefs.note: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by…
that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your…
When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again…
“ ‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound…
therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of…
Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give…
For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

translations.web: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
translations.bsb: “Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.
translations.kjv: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
translations.asv: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with fearfulness;
